classification.difficultyReason: Justify similarity using shared and parallel-line angles, express the whole side as x+2, and solve the resulting corresponding-side proportion with x on both sides.

content.prompt: Show that $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle ADE$. Hence, determine the value of $x$.

spec.description: Nested triangles with A–C–E and A–B–D collinear, matching parallel arrows on BC and DE. Decorative cyan fill omitted.
spec.mathematics: AC=x, CE=2, BC=5, DE=7; BC parallel to DE.
spec.answerVisibility: All givens visible; no answer supplied.

answer.worked:
$\angle BAC=\angle DAE$ (shared angle), $\angle ABC=\angle ADE$ and $\angle ACB=\angle AED$ (corresponding angles, $BC\parallel DE$). Therefore, $\triangle ABC\sim\triangle ADE$ (AAA).

$$\begin{align*}\frac{DE}{BC}&=\frac{AE}{AC}\\\frac{7}{5}&=\frac{x+2}{x}\\7x&=5(x+2)\\7x&=5x+10\\2x&=10\\x&=5\end{align*}$$
